name: ronin
pack_note: frames are trimmed to their opaque bounds and shelf-packed; cell = the bake cell before trimming; pivot = feet point of the cell
rect_origin: bottom-left (Unity sprite rect convention); pivot normalised within the rect
pivot_note: feet centre (10 px above the untrimmed cell bottom), normalised within each trimmed rect; sprites face right (flip for left)
hand_note: frames[].hand = left hand offset from the pivot in world units, unflipped
stride_note: animations[].stride = world units the body travels per cycle at 1x with the planted foot not skating (run, sprint; 0 = none)
emissive_encoding: R = katana blade (tier), G = eye dots, B = unused (hat brim is a dark albedo trim)
normal_encoding: view-space normal: R=+X right, G=+Y up, B=toward camera; transparent texels (128,128,255,0)
